what: Best-achievable net benefit from an equal-variance binormal ROC — nb_binormal
title: Best-achievable net benefit from an equal-variance binormal ROC — nb_binormal
text: Net benefit read equal-variance binormal ROC (separation mu) operating point whose slope equals cost ratio ((1 - pi) / pi) * (pt / (1 - pt)). always uses optimal cutoff, calibration-independent, best-achievable net benefit ROC – summary-metric counterpart nb_exact.

what: Net benefit of thresholded predictions at a target prevalence — nb_exact
title: Net benefit of thresholded predictions at a target prevalence — nb_exact
text: Decision-curve net benefit treating (surveying) every unit whose predicted probability least threshold pt, case-weighted target landscape prevalence reweight: $$NB(p_t) = TP_w - FP_w \cdot \frac{p_t}{1 - p_t},$$ \(TP_w\) \(FP_w\) prevalence-weighted true- false-positive fractions. calibration-dependent (per-point) route: thresholds probabilities given.

title: Net benefit of thresholded predictions at a target prevalence — nb_exact
text: Numeric vector net benefit, one per element pt.

title: Prevalence case weights — reweight
text: Case weights re-price evaluation sample target landscape prevalence. Every presence receives weight pi / n1 every absence (1 - pi) / n0, total presence weight pi, total absence weight 1 - pi, weights sum 1. Thresholded summaries (recall, precision, net benefit) computed weights behave sample drawn prevalence pi.
